profile.subtitleJa: 使徒言行録16章の幻で名が挙がる古代地域名。
profile.summaryJa: バルカン半島南東部に関わる歴史的地域名です。使徒言行録16章9節では、幻の中で「マケドニアに渡って助けてほしい」と求められます。古代の地域・ローマ属州と現代の国家・地域を同一視しません。

facts.textJa: 幻を見た後、パウロ一行はマケドニアへ渡るよう神に招かれたと結論した。

profile.modernLocationJa: バルカン半島南東部の歴史的地域。境界は時代で異なり、現代国家の領域とは区別する。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 幻の中で助けを求める呼びかけに名が現れる地域。
profile.locationNoteJa: 候補座標はプロフィールに昇格していない。Pleiades固定データまたは考古学機関の該当資料を個別に照合できていないためcoordinate=null。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.
When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.
Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.
When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.
